scope: All 22 fixed-source photographs and their frozen crop proposals; baseline versus removal of only the diameter contrast reward. Same 10-second fitting budget and existing geometry, paper, feature and 3% observed-mask gates. No model inference or per-photo best-arm selection.
coverage: Both arms carry complete bilinear source support through binary handoff, independent scoring and editable conversion. Missing source pixels are not classified artwork. This is an evaluation correction; clipped cases may differ from earlier coverage-blind runs.
independentReferences: Existing six approximate visible references; fixed notch/right/tip/left corner correspondence. No annotations enter cropping or fitting.
review: Inspect every exported weave and changes relative to original baseline; record failures without relaxing gates.
